# E47-D02 accessibility design audit catalogue

<!-- Generated by docs/plan/a11y/_tools/catalogue.py from 47-audit-register.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Auditor agent-run (E47-D02 lane), 2026-10-31, over the E47-T01 register at sha `a6ec967627b7`. A text-first design audit of every id SCR-001 to SCR-159 in `14-screens-catalogue.md`: the T01 observed findings and the merged spec-level a11y design reviews, joined per screen, normalised to four severities and routed to one design owner (E47-D03 to E47-D10) or to engineering-only with a reason. Design reviews are spec-level: cited as findings, never counted as conformance evidence. Partial against #1301: the open items are listed in section 4.

| Id                  | Source           | SC           | Level | Severity                  | Design remedy                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Design owner                                                                                        | Remediation story          |

| A11Y-F-0009         | E47-T01 register | 1.4.10       | AA    | minor (source: moderate)  | The dialog reflows to 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | E47-D04: reflow at 320 CSS px belongs with the layout and landmark model                            | E47-T01 #1323              |
| A11Y-F-0010         | E47-T01 register | 2.2.1        | A     | minor (source: moderate)  | 2.2.1: warn at least 20 s before the time limit and offer a simple way to continue. A remedy may only re-issue a fresh challenge on request; it never extends the old one or softens the factor (BQ-10): (a) a re-issue is a new server-issued challenge_id with the same factors; the step-up failure count (the session's failures_remaining), the read-only downgrade after the third failure and the auth.step_up_required audit continue across a re-issue, which never resets the count; (b) at expiry the typed password and code are discarded, never retained or replayed into the new challenge; only the held, non-secret action state survives; the pre-expiry warning renders only the remaining time of the server's challenge_expires_at. The TTL and the failure count never change. Note: Whether the 'essential' exception covers a security challenge window is for the second rater / security lens; no exception is claimed here (Level A cannot carry a nomination). Adjudication: filed in #5196 (filing go, decision 2a; owner the auth surfaces, E09).
